dish: chicken & gyro over rice with white sauce
address: SW corner of W 53rd St & 6th Ave, New York, NY 10019
w: The 1990 cart that made NYC chicken-and-gyro-over-rice famous, still drawing a line down the block at the southwest corner of 53rd & 6th until the early hours — the white sauce (and the red) started here.
Astoria's Vendy Award-winning Palestinian cart-turned-storefront — fava-free chickpea falafel and hand-shaved shawarma from a recipe traced to Ramallah; a citywide street-food benchmark.
sources: New York's Best Street Food winner

dish: chicken over rice with the green sauce
w: The Jackson Heights halal cart that won a Vendy on the strength of its bright green sauce — chicken and lamb over rice served late into the night at 73rd & Broadway.
